mapper.sql: c.id, c.content, c.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.name, c.user_name) AS userName, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to AS replyTo, COALESCE(reply_user.name, c.reply_to_name) AS replyToUserName, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment child WHERE child.parent_id = c.id AND child.is_deleted = 0) AS replyCount

c.id, c.content, c.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.name, c.user_name) AS userName, COALESCE(u.telephone, c.user_telephone) AS userTelephone, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to AS replyTo, COALESCE(reply_user.name, c.reply_to_name) AS replyToUserName, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment child WHERE child.parent_id = c.id AND child.is_deleted = 0) AS replyCount
mapper.select: SELECT FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user reply_user ON reply_user.id = c.reply_to WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user reply_user ON reply_user.id = c.reply_to WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user reply_user ON reply_user.id = c.reply_to ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user reply_user ON reply_user.id = c.reply_to WHERE c.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, content, user_id AS userId, user_name AS userName, user_telephone AS userTelephone, parent_id AS parentId, reply_to AS replyTo, reply_to_name AS replyToUserName, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM comment WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET is_deleted = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 1
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, c.user_id AS userId, c.user_name AS userName, c.user_telephone AS userTelephone, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to AS replyTo, c.reply_to_name AS replyToUserName, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM comment c WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
